title: マリ軍政打倒へ、過激派が国民に蜂起要求　イスラム法導入も
extracted_text:
【ナイロビ=共同】西アフリカ・マリで遊牧民の反政府勢力と共に複数都市を一斉攻撃したイスラム過激派が、マリ軍事政権の打倒に向け国民に蜂起を要求する声明を出した。シャリア（イスラム法）の導入も求めた。

ロイター通信が1日伝えた。攻撃から2日で1週間。過激派側は攻勢を続け、軍政を支援するロシアにも打撃となっている。

過激派は国際テロ組織アルカイダ系「イスラムとムスリムの支援団（JNIM）」。遊牧民トゥアレグのアザワド解放戦線（FLA）と4月25日、首都バマコなどを攻撃し、ロシアとの協力を主導したとされるカマラ暫定国防相を殺害した。

FLAを中心に北部キダルを制圧し、要衝都市ガオなどの制圧も狙う。ロシア国防省傘下の要員はキダルから撤退し、フランスメディアによるとマリ軍政高官から「裏切られた」との声が出た。

AP通信によると、FLAは1日、北部テッサリトの軍政側拠点を新たに制圧したと主張した。

英BBC放送はバマコに通じる複数の幹線道路をJNIMが断続的に封鎖していると報道。バマコは昨年秋にもJNIMに封鎖され、燃料不足で市民生活に影響が出た。

JNIMは2017年結成。イヤド・アグガリ指導者は12年にマリ北部を制圧した過激派の一つアンサル・ディーンを率いた。当時もシャリアを導入し、世界遺産都市トンブクトゥで聖廟（せいびょう）を破壊。戦争犯罪などで国際刑事裁判所（ICC）の逮捕状が出ている。

JNIMは近年、勢力伸長が顕著で、マリと同様に軍政下でロシアとの協力を進めたブルキナファソやニジェールの他、ベナンなどでテロを行う。今回の事態が地域の一層の不安定化につながることが懸念される。

ロシアは「過激主義との戦いを続ける」（ペスコフ大統領報道官）としマリ軍政を支える構え。ただウクライナ侵略下で支援拡大は困難とみられる。事態を収拾できなければ「ロシアの安全保障能力に対する各国の信用は損なわれる」（研究者）との指摘もある。

translated_text:
[Nairobi=Kyodo] Islamic extremist groups that attacked multiple cities simultaneously alongside nomadic anti-government forces in Mali have issued a statement demanding a national uprising to topple the Mali military regime. They also called for the introduction of Sharia (Islamic law). Reported by Reuters on the 1st. One week has passed since the attacks. The extremist side continues to offensive, dealing blows to Russia, which supports the military regime.

The extremists are al-Qaida-linked "Jamaat Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM)." Together with the Tuareg nomads' Azawad Liberation Front (FLA), they attacked Bamako and other cities on April 25, killing interim Defense Minister Kamara, who was said to be leading cooperation with Russia.

Centered on FLA, they have seized northern Kidal and are also targeting key cities such as Gao. Personnel under the Russian Defense Ministry have withdrawn from Kidal, and according to French media, there are voices from Mali military regime officials saying they have been "betrayed."

According to AP, FLA claimed on the 1st to have seized a new military regime base in northern Tessalit.

BBC reports that JNIM has intermittently blocked multiple highways leading to Bamako. Bamako was also blockaded by JNIM last fall, affecting citizens' daily lives due to fuel shortages.

JNIM was formed in 2017. Its leader, Iyad Ag Ghaly, led the extremist group Ansar Dine, which seized northern Mali in 2012. At that time, they also introduced Sharia and destroyed shrines in the World Heritage city of Timbuktu. Arrest warrants have been issued by the International Criminal Court (ICC) for war crimes and other offenses.

JNIM has been notably expanding its power in recent years, and has carried out terrorism in Burkina Faso and Niger, which like Mali have deepened cooperation with Russia under military regimes, as well as in Benin. There are concerns that the current situation could lead to further instability in the region.

Russia stated it will "continue fighting extremism" (Presidential press secretary Peskov) and appears supporting the Mali military regime. However, expanding support is seen as difficult given the Ukraine invasion. If the situation cannot be resolved, "countries' trust in Russia's security capabilities will be damaged" according to analysts.
title_en: Extremists Demand National Uprising to Topple Mali Military Regime; Also Call for Islamic Law
